steps.title: Meeting Saradomin
steps.text: Speak to Sir Owen in the garden north of the Edgeville Monastery.
steps.warning: For the tracking to work properly, you need to have the chat visible, game messages set to 'On', and chat timestamps on.

actions.text: The who with the what now?
I guess I have one of those faces.
Saradomin must have had a good reason...

steps.text: Talk to Saradomin after the cutscene.
[Accept Quest]
Pick up the suit of armour just south-west of you.
Equip the armor.
Talk to Saradomin.

actions.text: Yes, teleport us to the Black Knights' Fortress.

postconditions.text: recover the weapon at any cost

steps.title: Infiltrating the fortress
steps.text: Open the Portcullis.

Fortress guard:
  • Dismiss pets & familiars before proceeding.

actions.text: No, I have something... special planned for him.

postconditions.text: Now let's find a way up to the next level.

steps.text: Talk to Lieutenant York to the north.

actions.text: Are you suggesting I cannot handle a mere knight of Saradomin?

steps.text: Climb up staircase to the north-west. The fortress guard will stop you.

actions.text: This prisoner is to be sacrificed.

steps.text: Head to the 1st floor (2nd floor[US]) to the south, talk to Hierophant Marius.

actions.text: I shall return after I deal with this Temple Knight.

postconditions.text: may proceed up the south-east stairs

steps.text: Climb up staircase. The fortress guard will stop you.

actions.text: I am bringing him to the tallest tower.
We need him to recover the weapon of power, as you know.

steps.text: Talk to Lieutenant Graves.

actions.text: Stand aside. I will handle this.

steps.text: Search the Lieutenant's body.

steps.title: The ritual
steps.text: Climb the stairs to the north-east.
Exit the dialogue. Search the wardrobe.
Search the box of candles.
Search the shelf.
Pick up the Grimoire and read it.
Read the Grimoire.
Fix each candle stand.
Light the candles.
Repair the Ritual circle.

actions.text: Use the chalk to repair the magic circle.

steps.text:
Chant over the north-west candle.
  • Arom
  • Nahrea
  • Imperium
steps.warning: Make sure you choose the correct order.

steps.text:
Chant over the north-east candle.
  • Feritas
  • Silenti
  • Sepulchrum
steps.warning: Make sure you choose the correct order.

steps.text:
Chant over the south-east candle.
  • Igasac
  • Perdimit
  • Ebulam
steps.warning: Make sure you choose the correct order.

steps.text:
Enter the portal.
  • You must remove the suit of armour that was equipped at the beginning of the quest.

steps.title: The Saradominist crypt
steps.text: Defeat the three Black Knights.
Search the bodies.

postconditions.text: You recover a small metal key

steps.text: Unlock the hanging cage.
Talk to Dawn and learn all she knows.

postconditions.text: There's snow at the surface entrance
We devote our time to music

actions.text: How did the Kinshra capture you?

postconditions.text: If you hadn't arrived when you

steps.text:
Enter the doorway to the east.
  • Optional: Search the supply crate south of the portal first.
Inspect the looted coffin.
Open the portcullis to the south.

steps.title: Fern
steps.text: Talk to Fern.

actions.text: I am ready to be judged.

postconditions.text: I must ensure you have the strength

actions.text: I fight to protect the innocent.

steps.text:
Defeat Fern.
  • Dodge her charge attack.
  • Optional: Loot the dead black knights for some coins.

steps.title: The Wand of Resurrection
steps.text: Click on the wand.

Matching two tiles at a time to solve the puzzle.
  • There's an image on the wiki you can refer to. This will be tracked in a later version.
steps.warning: Tracking is based on position. It won't be accurate.

steps.text: Try to take the wand.

actions.text: I shall sacrifice my own blood.

steps.title: Fighting for the wand
steps.text: Talk to Dawn to the north.

actions.text: Give me the wand or you won't live to regret it.

steps.text: Defeat the Black Knights and Sir Owen.
steps.warning: There's no tracking for this step.

steps.text: Go north and open the portcullis.

Kill Dawn.
  • Refer to the wiki guide if you're having trouble.
Search Dawn's body.

steps.title: Saradomin and the wand
steps.text: Enter the Portcullis to the south.

Speak with Saradomin.
  • Optional: When asked to be teleported back to Edgeville, it is recommended to stay in the tombs to claim the extra post-quest rewards which require level 40 Strength and two other coffins requiring level 60 and 80 Strength.

actions.text: I will give you the wand.
